  <strong>Runtime debug:</strong>
  <pre id="runtime-debug-log" style="margin: 6px 0 0 0; white-space: pre-wrap;"></pre>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const box = document.getElementById("runtime-debug");
  const log = document.getElementById("runtime-debug-log");
  const append = (msg) => {
    if (!box || !log) return;
    box.style.display = "block";
    log.textContent += (log.textContent ? "\n" : "") + msg;
  };
  window.addEventListener("error", (e) => append(`error: ${e.message}`));
  window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e) => append(`promise: ${e.reason}`));
})();
</script>

```{ojs}
manifest = await FileAttachment("artifacts/dashboard/manifest.json").json()
cells = await FileAttachment("artifacts/dashboard/cells.json").json()
amplitudes = await FileAttachment("artifacts/dashboard/amplitudes.json").json()

tColors = [
  "#2a9d8f", "#45b39d", "#8ab17d", "#f4a261", "#e76f51", "#c77dff",
  "#6d597a", "#4cc9f0", "#4895ef", "#4361ee", "#3a0ca3"
]

rankedWaves = manifest.waves
  .map(wave => ({
    wave,
    intensity: amplitudes
      .filter(d => d.wave === wave)
      .reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.intensity, 0)
  }))
  .sort((a, b) => b.intensity - a.intensity)
  .map((d, i) => ({...d, rank: i + 1}))

function colorForCell(c, minv, maxv) {
  const base = tColors[c.t_index - 1] ?? "#90a4ae"
  const v = Math.log10(c.total_intensity + 1)
  const ratio = (v - minv) / (maxv - minv + 1e-12)
  const alpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ratio))
  return `${base}${Math.round(alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
}

function matrixInput(cells, selected = {m_index: 1, t_index: 1}) {
  const wrap = html`<div class="matrix-wrap"></div>`

  let current = selected
  Object.defineProperty(wrap, "value", {
    get() { return current },
    set(v) { current = v }
  })

  const vals = cells.map(d => Math.log10(d.total_intensity + 1))
  const minv = Math.min(...vals)
  const maxv = Math.max(...vals)

  for (let ti = 1; ti <= manifest.n_t; ti++) {
    const tb = manifest.tprime_bins[ti - 1]
    const row = html`<div class="matrix-row"></div>`
    const label = html`<div class="matrix-row-label">${tb.low.toFixed(3)}–${tb.high.toFixed(3)}</div>`
    const grid = html`<div class="cell-grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(${manifest.n_m}, 12px)"></div>`

    for (const c of cells.filter(d => d.t_index === ti).sort((a, b) => a.m_index - b.m_index)) {
      const btn = html`<button class="cell-btn" aria-label="m ${c.m_index}, t ${c.t_index}"></button>`
      btn.title = `m(3π) ${c.m_center.toFixed(2)} GeV/c²; t' ${c.t_low.toFixed(3)}–${c.t_high.toFixed(3)} (GeV/c)²; total intensity ${c.total_intensity.toFixed(2)}`
      btn.style.background = colorForCell(c, minv, maxv)

      if (c.m_index === current.m_index && c.t_index === current.t_index) btn.classList.add("active")

      btn.onclick = () => {
        current = {m_index: c.m_index, t_index: c.t_index}
        for (const b of wrap.querySelectorAll(".cell-btn")) b.classList.remove("active")
        btn.classList.add("active")
        wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"))
      }
      grid.append(btn)
    }
    row.append(label, grid)
    wrap.append(row)
  }

  wrap.append(html`<div class="mass-axis"><span>${manifest.m3pi[0].toFixed(2)}</span><span>m(3π) [GeV/c²]</span><span>${manifest.m3pi[manifest.n_m - 1].toFixed(2)}</span></div>`)
  wrap.append(html`<div class="matrix-caption">Rows are t' bins; columns are m(3π) bins. Shade encodes total intensity. Click any cell to update the plots and local ranking.</div>`)

  return wrap
}
```

```{ojs}
selectedCellSummary = cells.find(d => d.m_index === selectedCell.m_index && d.t_index === selectedCell.t_index)

activeT = selectedCell.t_index
activeM = selectedCell.m_index

waveSeries = amplitudes
  .filter(d => d.wave === selectedWave.wave && d.t_index === activeT)
  .sort((a, b) => a.m_center - b.m_center)
  .map(d => ({
    ...d,
    i_lo: Math.max(0, d.intensity - (d.sigma_intensity ?? 0)),
    i_hi: d.intensity + (d.sigma_intensity ?? 0),
    re_lo: d.re - (d.sigma_re ?? 0),
    re_hi: d.re + (d.sigma_re ?? 0),
    im_lo: d.im - (d.sigma_im ?? 0),
    im_hi: d.im + (d.sigma_im ?? 0),
    is_selected_m: d.m_index === activeM
  }))

argandExtent = 1.05 * Math.max(
  ...waveSeries.flatMap(d => [
    Math.abs(d.re_lo), Math.abs(d.re_hi),
    Math.abs(d.im_lo), Math.abs(d.im_hi)
  ]),
  1e-12
)

cellWaveRows = amplitudes
  .filter(d => d.m_index === activeM && d.t_index === activeT)
  .sort((a, b) => b.intensity - a.intensity)

topWaves = cellWaveRows.map((d, i) => ({
  rank: i + 1,
  wave: d.wave,
  intensity: d.intensity,
  sigma_intensity: d.sigma_intensity ?? 0,
  phase: d.phase,
  re: d.re,
  im: d.im
}))
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 64,
  marginBottom: 50,
  width: 560,
  height: 410,
  x: {label: "m(3π) [GeV/c²]", grid: true},
  y: {label: "|A|² (intensity)", grid: true, nice: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.link(waveSeries, {x1: "m_center", y1: "i_lo", x2: "m_center", y2: "i_hi", stroke: "#84c9c3", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
    Plot.line(waveSeries, {x: "m_center", y: "intensity", stroke: "#0b7a75", strokeWidth: 2.4}),
    Plot.dot(waveSeries, {x: "m_center", y: "intensity", r: 2.5, fill: "#0b7a75"}),
    Plot.dot(waveSeries.filter(d => d.is_selected_m), {x: "m_center", y: "intensity", r: 6, fill: "#d62828", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 1.5})
  ]
})
```

Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 64,
  marginBottom: 50,
  width: 520,
  height: 520,
  x: {label: "RE(A)", domain: [-argandExtent, argandExtent], grid: true},
  y: {label: "IM(A)", domain: [-argandExtent, argandExtent], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#a9bdc6"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#a9bdc6"}),
    Plot.link(waveSeries, {x1: "re_lo", y1: "im", x2: "re_hi", y2: "im", stroke: "#84a8b8", strokeOpacity: 0.65, strokeWidth: 1}),
    Plot.link(waveSeries, {x1: "re", y1: "im_lo", x2: "re", y2: "im_hi", stroke: "#84a8b8", strokeOpacity: 0.65, strokeWidth: 1}),
    Plot.line(waveSeries, {x: "re", y: "im", stroke: "#1f4e79", strokeWidth: 2.2}),
    Plot.dot(waveSeries, {x: "re", y: "im", r: 3, fill: "#1f4e79"}),
    Plot.dot(waveSeries.filter(d => d.is_selected_m), {x: "re", y: "im", r: 6, fill: "#d62828", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 1.5})
  ]
})
